title: xdrip stopped working when I switched to 14 day libre
symptom: After switching from Libre 10-day sensors to Libre 14-day sensors, xDrip+ finds the Blucon but collects no data, even after purchasing a new Blucon and reinstalling xDrip+. The Blucon app works fine with the sensor.
cause: The Libre 14-day sensor is not yet supported by xDrip+ with Blucon; it currently works with mm2 and bubble, and only with a specific version published on the MM site.
fix: For Miaomiao 2 users, install the latest Alpha release of xDrip+, de-install Tomato and Glimp, reboot, and adjust Bluetooth settings (Settings / Less common settings / Bluetooth settings / Use scanning). For Blucon, no fix is available yet.
evidence_quote: Not easy to get working (I'm on miaomiao 2 and libre14 with a Pixel 2 phone. You'll need the latest Alpha release, de-install Tomato and Glimp, and re-boot afterwards. I also had to play with the bluetooth settings (Settings / Less common settings / Bluetooth settings / Use scanning)
